title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the magnetic field B must be provided.

title: Use of Ampère's Law
description: Important Criteria: The application of Ampère's circuital law must be correctly stated and used in the derivation.

title: Assumptions Stated
description: Important Criteria: The assumptions regarding the relationships between s, d, and R must be clearly articulated.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: The units of the final answer should be checked for consistency.

title: Neglecting Leakage
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning for neglecting magnetic leakage in the gap must be justified.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final expression must be identified.
